verdict.rationale: AngelList Stack Equity Management is a cap table product, so exit waterfall modeling is a fair axis to judge it on. However, the evidence pack never mentions waterfall analysis, exit scenarios, liquidation preferences, or participation. The only modeling evidence is an Excel pro forma for SAFE/note conversions, along with general report exports and a 409A request flow. None of these model proceeds per share class or stakeholder at different exit values, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run exit waterfall analyses showing proceeds per share class and stakeholder under different exit values, honoring preferences and participation
